info: View KEGG pathway genes

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(pathview)
```

Run initial pathview on autophagy -> save values & identify abs(max) value to set new color label range
```{r}
# Read in Vulko vs Expi data
df = read.csv("../results/DE/contrasts/contrast_Vulko_vs_Expi.csv")
df <- df %>% filter(padj<0.05)

# Prepare data for pathview
log2FC <-df$log2FoldChange
names(log2FC) <- df$X

# Run pathview
pv.out <- pathview(
  gene.data = log2FC, 
  pathway.id = '04140', 
  species = "hsa", 
  gene.idtype = "symbol"
)

# Save genes included in pathway & values
write.csv(pv.out$plot.data.gene, "../results/pathview/pathview.csv")
```
Function to round up to closest 1 digit (ex 3.04 -> 3.1) to ensure whole range is within color label
```{r}
round_up <- function(x) {
  scale <- 10^1
  ceiling(x * scale) / scale
}

# Extract gene log2FC
log2FC <- pv.out$plot.data.gene

# Find abs(max) gene value and round up to nearest 1 digit
max_val <- round_up(max(abs(log2FC$mol.data), na.rm = TRUE))

max_val
```

Rerun pathview with updated limit range
```{r}
# Read in Vulko vs Expi data
df = read.csv("../results/DE/contrasts/contrast_Vulko_vs_Expi.csv")
df <- df %>% filter(padj<0.05)

# Prepare data for pathview
log2FC <-df$log2FoldChange
names(log2FC) <- df$X

# Run pathview
pv.out <- pathview(
  gene.data = log2FC, 
  pathway.id = '04140', 
  species = "hsa", 
  gene.idtype = "symbol",
  limit = max_val
)
```
